nodes.description: IERC1155 token contract address stored at slot 0, set in constructor to a fixed address
Public uint256 sale price per NFT unit, default 0.2 ether
Public uint256 token id (36) being sold by the contract
Payable recipient address that receives the contract balance after each purchase
Public uint256 sale start timestamp gate compared against block.timestamp
Public payable entrypoint; enforces access/timing/amount/value checks then performs external NFT transfer and ETH transfer
Public view helper returning nft.balanceOf(address(this), id)
External pure ERC1155 receiver hook returning the selector; reachable via callback from the NFT transfer
Deploys contract, initializes multisig, start, nft and id state variables
Caller controlled address used as recipient and in the msg.sender == tx.origin gate
Miner-influenced timestamp compared with start to gate purchases
Origin address used in the msg.sender == tx.origin anti-contract check
External call nft.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, amount, new bytes(0x0)) executed before the ETH payout, invokes receiver hooks
External low-level ETH transfer multisig.transfer(address(this).balance) that forwards the whole contract balance
External call nft.balanceOf(address(this), id) used as the supply source of truth
User-supplied quantity of NFT units to buy in buy(uint256 amount)
Constructor parameter for the payout address
Constructor parameter for the sale start timestamp

edges.reason: User-controlled amount parameter is consumed by buy for amount <= supply() and msg.value checks
msg.sender is compared with tx.origin to enforce a no-contracts access restriction and used as NFT recipient
tx.origin drives the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) access-control branch in buy
block.timestamp gates purchap purchase in require(block.timestamp >= start), a timestamp dependency modelled as access_control
State variable start is compared against block.timestamp to open the sale, creating a time-based access condition
price state variable is multiplied by amount and compared to msg.value
nft state variable supplies the callee address for the safeTransferFrom external call
id state variable is passed as the token id argument to safeTransferFrom
amount parameter is forwarded as the value argument to safeTransferFrom
buy reaches an external call to the NFT contract before completing its accounting and payout
safeTransferFrom invokes the ERC1155 receiver hook onERC1155Received on the receiving contract
The receiver callback can re-enter buy while the ETH payout has not yet happened
multisig state variable is the destination of the ETH transfer
buy executes multisig.transfer(address(this).balance) after the NFT transfer
A state-changing external call precedes the full balance transfer, the classic reentrancy ordering in buy
buy calls supply() to validate the requested amount
The value returned by supply() flows back into the amount <= supply() require in buy
nft state variable supplies the callee for balanceOf inside supply
id state variable is passed to balanceOf to select the tracked token
supply() performs the external balanceOf call
balanceOf return value is returned as the supply() result
Constructor parameter _multisig is assigned to the multisig state variable
Constructor parameter _start is assigned to the start state variable
Constructor writes the multisig state variable
Constructor writes the start state variable
Constructor writes the nft state variable with a hardcoded token address
Constructor writes the id state variable to 36

normalization_plan.reason: Event-scoped parameter only meaningful inside buy(); fold into the buy function node
Deployment-time parameter used only to initialize the multisig state variable inside the constructor
Deployment-time parameter used only to initialize the start state variable inside the constructor
